I replied to Hollis in a thread on their message in #central-team. I told them the only deadline on record is 25 August, from Pree's message in that channel on 14 October.

The deadline isn't settled. Two days ago I pointed out to Pree that 25 August this year has already passed and asked what date they meant, but they haven't answered. I suggested Hollis check with Pree before updating the account sheet.

I only looked in channels Hollis belongs to. That's #central-team, and #inc-tansley-carrier-api, which only has a September 2025 outage and no deadline.

My summary from the last request was posted into #central-team as a separate message, so the whole team can see it. It doesn't contain anything sensitive.
